text.p: Oshman's Sporting Goods Inc said Thursday its amended financing agreement with CIT Group/Business Credit Inc provides for a $15 million increase on the existing line of credit and extends the term of the agreement two years, through August 1999.
Chief Executive Alvin Lubetkin said the company has a "two-level" financing agreement that now provides a base loan limit of $70 million and $85 million in peak periods.

The company also said it launched two new megastores during the third quarter, ended November 2, and two during the month of November. This "completes our store expansion plans with seven stores" for the current fiscal year, it said.
"We plan to continue to expand our megastore concept in 1997 with the opening of at least seven additional stores in new and existing markets," it said.

Oshman's also said it has "accelerated the closings of our underperforming traditional stores and at the end of the third quarter had closed 11 stores, with an additional six closed during November. We expect there will be additional traditional stores closed" during the fourth quarter.
Oshman's currently operates 123 sporting goods specialty stores, including 31 megastores, in 18 states.
